authority.policy: Only mutate R48. No merge, force-push, release, raw-data upload or destructive cache removal.

gates.name: theory-contract
required: derivation or primary source for each model response
deny: BI map promoted to general Bianchi

gates.name: likelihood-contract
deny: summary added to raw likelihood without conditional factorization

gates.name: code-change
deny: changing theory only to match code

precedence: raw source bytes and release docs
unverified memory or prior assistant statement
self_audit: Every numerical constant has source/derivation/calibration or is an explicit nuisance.
Every tensor has type, units, tetrad, frame, epoch and rotation law.
Every dataset has overlap, mask, selection, shared calibration and covariance audit.
Every novelty statement names the closest prior art and exact difference.
Every success status has a current execution receipt.
forbidden: No raw data or chains in Git
No five independent x,Q,Pi,F,G_F likelihood terms
No diagonal cut-sky harmonic covariance without derivation
No BI substitution for Bianchi V/VII_h
No stale receipt without exact identities

stops: Stop only the affected claim when its data/transfer is missing; continue independent theory work.
After one adversarial review and one repair pass decide PASS_SCOPED, FAIL or BLOCKED.
Never erase previous failures from ledger.
agent_dispatch: NOT_RUN in ChatGPT authoring session. Local agent execution is delegated by restart prompt.
